decision: Prepare a locally bundled Tiptap React editor using exact 3.30.3 packages, npm lockfile v3 and pinned optional peers; integrate later as an Author Studio-only lazy-loaded bundle that serializes the structured chapter schema.
invariants: All locked packages must pass the existing licence and registry provenance gate.
Tiptap optional peer packages are pinned to the same 3.30.3 release.
No Tiptap code is added to the shared reader/community island bundle.
No paid features, hosted services, D1 migrations, or production deployment are introduced.
The editor must serialize only to the validated imperial_rich_text_chapter v1 envelope.
acceptance: npm ci succeeds from the committed lockfile.
All locked packages have reviewed permissive licence metadata and npm registry provenance.
The temporary lockfile-generation workflow steps are removed before merge.
A later editor implementation is lazy-loaded only on Author Studio and passes mobile, accessibility, security and bundle-size checks.
releaseBoundary: Dependency preparation only. Editor UI remains a separate implementation step.
